title.en: Rename Customer to Client in the admin table

rationale.en: The ticket asks to "rename Customer to Client in the admin table" (labels only); the admin customers table and its tests live in apps/admin/customers/.

bobReport: Done. Renamed Customer to Client in the admin table only. No API or database changes. All tests pass.
